author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Before reduced the three folded bands to three identical single-stroke chevrons, so it read as a 'scroll up' arrow. Now three outlined band cells are stacked on a centre crease, and their fold lines progress from peaked (top) through flat (middle) to V (bottom), as in the reference.
omissions: The white gaps between the bands: three bands of thickness 8 plus two gaps of 8 fill the 40-unit height exactly, leaving no room for any fold, so the bands share their fold lines.
